label: B25-JTAG-RX-VENDOR-TIMING

board_trigger.result: The exact corrected SOF reaches BOOT/READY, but a clean first ordinary-file terminal session receives no status, PONG or Z echo.
board_trigger.remaining_scope_before_this_task: candidate host-to-target path after the JTAG Atlantic endpoint

coverage: Quartus 21.4 registered waitrequest recurrence and registered DATA/CONTROL selector
registered RVALID and showahead-OFF RX FIFO q timing
vendor TX full behavior: accepted write plus overflow instead of behavioral backpressure
isolated bridge address mapping, exactly-once side effects, backpressure and reset
complete no-FP PC=0 monitor in CAL-OK/CAL-WAIT/CAL-FAIL paths
65,536 empty vendor DATA transactions before host RX injection
p/PONG, Z echo and ?/status after the long empty-poll interval

testbench_diagnostic.initial_result: The first vendor full-SoC run reached all commands and exactly 65,536 empty reads but failed only the same-cycle bridge/model TX event assertion in all three calibration scenarios.
testbench_diagnostic.root_cause: The vendor model performs its FIFO side effect during the registered high-waitrequest phase; the bridge emits its accepted-write pulse during the following low phase. The behavioral-only same-cycle assertion was invalid for that protocol.
testbench_diagnostic.fix: Delay only the vendor model event by one cycle before comparing valid/character; retain the same-cycle comparison for the behavioral model and retain final count equality checks.
testbench_diagnostic.classification: testbench-observer-fix, not a production RTL fix

conclusion.statement: The current production JTAG-UART bridge consumes delayed RX exactly once and returns PONG/status/echo after a long vendor-timed empty-poll interval. No deterministic failure exists at the modeled Avalon/bridge/monitor boundary, so speculative production RTL edits are forbidden.
uncovered_physical_boundaries: the live JTAG Atlantic host-to-target transport and long-lived standard-server state
the synthesized vendor CDC/FIFO implementation before the Avalon DATA register
physical observation of whether a host byte reaches DATA.RVALID on the candidate

next: Before adding physical instrumentation, use the new T-20260920-003 finding to perform one bounded corrected-candidate control with a delayed read-only jtagconfig -n rescan before the first terminal. If RX still fails, add physical read-count/RVALID/last-byte observability and rebuild through the required gates.
